name: Hudson Electronics UK
dirt_evidence: Blackbird octave fuzz; Bluebird Fuzzrite; Broadcast preamps; Full Range Bomb; Fuzz Mk IV; Gospel Bomb; Motorcycle Overdrive; Mr. Soul; Overdrive 999; Overdrive Eight Fifty; Sidecar; Soul Bomb; Stroll On; White Heat
notes: Michael Hudson, Beverley UK. Effects Database indexes 22 products and describes hand-built fuzz/overdrive work. High-priority Queue B catalog target.

name: Kurosawa Musical Instruments
dirt_evidence: The Fuzz
notes: Rare Japanese fuzz attributed to Kurosawa Gakki. Exact physical manufacturer remains uncertain, so preserve as a brand/manufacturing-attribution node rather than asserting a factory identity.

name: J&H
dirt_evidence: Hella Fuzz
notes: Effects Database records 49 units built between 2015-2017. Extremely small historical run, exactly the type of micro-builder the census should preserve.

name: Systech
dirt_evidence: Overdrive
notes: Systems & Technology in Music, Inc. of Kalamazoo. Effects Database identifies a mid-1970s Overdrive and a broader effects catalog; lineage includes Greg Hochman, Charlie Wicks and the Sound Factory.

name: Bob Burt Cabinets & Pedals
dirt_evidence: Overdrive; AH-1 distortion; GR8T Distortion; Clean Boost
notes: Bob Burt hand-built cabinets and pedals in Milton, Florida. Effects Database documents a 2000 start, 2007 Overdrive prototype and later distortion/boost products.

name: PedalWorX
dirt_evidence: Bender-Over-Under; Dirty Angel; HellBilly Hybrid Fuzz; McFuzz; McFuzz Hot; Neo-Drive; New York Over Driver; Octabooty; SRV-808; Tejas; Texas Two Step; ZZT-808
notes: Partnership between Bob McBroom and George Blekas, founded 2000. Effects Database indexes 21 products, many in the dirt category.

name: DB Design
dirt_evidence: Lemon Fuzz
notes: Effects Database documents a completely hand-built germanium fuzz. Geography and broader company identity need follow-up.

name: SynthRestore
dirt_evidence: Model OC8 Fuzz
notes: One-product historical builder entry. UK hand-built OC8 using vintage-style components; preserve even though catalog is tiny.

name: Bautner
dirt_evidence: DB-1 Distortion; MB-1 Heavy Metal; ODB-1 Over-Drive
notes: Effects Database records a 9-product historical Brazilian brand founded circa 1984? and links Brazilian Guitar Museum. Exact manufacturing relationships require later archival work.

name: Asama Engineering
dirt_evidence: Over Drive
notes: Effects Database ties Asama Engineering to Coron Musical Instrument Co. and a wider Coron/Seiwa/Storm/Bias overdrive family. Preserve Asama as a branded node while linking the OEM manufacturer separately.

name: Seiwa
dirt_evidence: Over Drive
notes: Japanese overdrive brand with Coron-built product in the documented family. Important for private-label/OEM census coverage.

name: Storm by Coron
dirt_evidence: Over Drive
notes: Storm-branded overdrive documented as built by Coron Musical Instrument Co. Keep brand and manufacturer as separate entities.

name: FBT
dirt_evidence: A-608-B Distorsion; Fuzz FF III
notes: Effects Database lists FBT alongside Cicognani and indexes dedicated distortion and fuzz products. Later lineage/ownership should be mapped separately.

name: A.Y.A
dirt_evidence: Bass Fuzz; BM-Fuzz 70; BM-Fuzz 80; Drivesta; Frontgate Bass Drive
notes: Located in Tokyo and run by Makoto Kawai. Effects Database indexes multiple gain/fuzz products.

name: Dazatronyx
dirt_evidence: Muff-Fuzz and other fuzz/gain products
notes: Melbourne handmade pedal builder. Effects Database currently indexes 11 products; fuzz is explicitly documented.

name: Elite Tone
dirt_evidence: Fillmore Thunder; Fusion-Drive; Fuzz Monster; Fuzz Monster II; Octane Boost; Smooth Boost
notes: David Nelson, Minnesota. Effects Database documents a 2002 first pedal, 2008 Elite Tone launch and multiple dirt products.

name: EFX Custom Effects
dirt_evidence: Blues Maker; Bold as Fuzz; Bass Driver; Distortion and other gain products
notes: São Paulo company of Eugenio Gregorio, started 2002 and formalized 2009. Effects Database indexes 72 products across effects types, including substantial dirt coverage.

name: Audio Monk / Nina Electronics
dirt_evidence: Fuzzbeard; Fuzzpotion bass fuzz; Rubie Drive
notes: Anthony Pelosi first built pedals under Nina Electronics, then changed the name to Audio Monk. Preserve both labels in the lineage graph rather than treating them as unrelated builders.

name: Mellowtone
dirt_evidence: Melx Fuzz 2; Melxowtone; Supra Fuzz; Trumpet Fuzz; Wolf Computer variants
notes: Eric Edvalson, Richland Washington. Effects Database indexes 16 products and a sizable fuzz catalog.

name: VL Effects
dirt_evidence: Bullitt OD-One; Tone Invaders Fuzz; Bullitt and other gain variants
notes: Vincent Loret in Paris. Effects Database says first VL Effects pedals were built in 1982 and indexes eight products, including dedicated overdrive and fuzz.

name: Master Effects
dirt_evidence: Happy Trails Overdrive; Teh Brootz; Wolfy
notes: Calgary-based builder that designs, develops and builds guitar effects. Effects Database indexes a compact catalog with documented gain products.

name: Plan-9
dirt_evidence: 66 Bender Ge; 67 Bender MkII Ge; 68 Classic Fuzz; 72 Stonner Machine II; Fuzz Mutante; Fuzzy Overdriver; Muffin Fuzzy Distortion II; Octofuzz; Power Driver; Psycho Fuzz; Ram's Head variants; Super Wild Fuzz; Suppa Fuzz; Tone Ranger
notes: São Paulo builder run by Orlando Marcondes Ferreira Neto. Effects Database indexes 19 products, most of them dirt-focused.

name: Cause & Effect Pedals / CE Pedals
dirt_evidence: FET Dream smooth overdrive/distortion
notes: Run by Mark Roberts and Brian Alexson in Ontario. First commercial FET Dream shipments were in 2009; preserve as a small but documented builder.
